# Fixture for PERF-PY-26 (safe): recursive-descent parse_* in a token loop
lang: python
file: parser.py
---
class Parser:
    def parse(self):
        while not self.at_end():
            if self.check("MAIN"):
                main = self.parse_main_block()
            elif self.check("DEF"):
                self.parse_function()
            else:
                self.advance()
        return main

    def parse_main_block(self):
        return ("main", self.parse_statements())

    def parse_function(self):
        return ("fn", self.parse_statements())

    def parse_statements(self):
        return []
